name: Camera Gear & Firmware Watch
tagline: Watches your camera kit and wishlist; Fridays bring the firmware news.
description: Keeps an eye on the camera bodies, lenses, and drones you own or want. A Friday digest tells you when new firmware lands (with what changed) and when used prices at MPB, KEH, and B&H hit your targets. Web only, and it never buys anything. For photographers, videographers, and gear nerds.
author: gzikry
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
